title: Bias Neutralization Framework: Measuring Fairness in Large Language Models with Bias Intelligence Quotient (BiQ)

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a Bias Intelligence Quotient (BiQ) from responses to targeted prompts, which aggregates keyword analysis, sentiment analysis (using tools like TextBlob and Roberta), semantic embeddings, diversity penalties, and context sensitivity.

Calculating a Bias Intelligence Quotient (BiQ) from responses to targeted prompts, evaluating the model's nuanced understanding of specific cultural and historical narratives (e.g., Black culture and history).
Calculating a Bias Intelligence Quotient (BiQ) from responses to gender-focused prompts, measuring explicit or implicit language preferences, sentiment distribution, and keyword frequencies.
Calculating a Bias Intelligence Quotient (BiQ) from responses to prompts concerning social class, gentrification, and poverty, evaluating sentiment and keyword associations.
Calculating a Bias Intelligence Quotient (BiQ) from responses to prompts regarding LGBTQ+ identities and issues, assessing sentiment neutrality and contextual sensitivity.
Calculating a Bias Intelligence Quotient (BiQ) from responses to prompts regarding diverse family structures, single parenthood, and caregiving, analyzing sentiment and representation.
